PROC

NOT DB_CampNight_Completed((FLAG)NIGHT_NightsongShadowheartVisit_5cf06d9e-44ce-4431-a1c6-839bfdad5f79)

SetFlag(NIGHT_NightsongShadowheartVisit_5cf06d9e-44ce-4431-a1c6-839bfdad5f79, NULL_00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, 0);

PROC

PROC

AND

AND
GetPosition(S_CRE_BloodOfLathander_GeneratorBottom_ea4331cf-a5dd-4cc5-9cca-d2a70c3e3447, _X, _Y, _Z)
THEN
PROC_SetOnStage(_Barrier, 1);

IF
AttackedBy(S_CRE_LathanderStatue_Sunset_4bb6dfc7-c5ad-474b-b4b6-a265d82c4cba, _,_Player,_,_DamageAmount, _,_)
AND
DB_Players((CHARACTER)_Player)
AND
NOT DB_CRE_StatuePuzzle_Rotatable(S_CRE_LathanderStatue_Sunset_4bb6dfc7-c5ad-474b-b4b6-a265d82c4cba)
AND
_DamageAmount>=10
THEN

Use((CHARACTER)_Player, S_CRE_LathanderStatue_Sunset_4bb6dfc7-c5ad-474b-b4b6-a265d82c4cba, "");

IF
TemplateRemovedFrom(_Template, (ITEM)_Item, _Double)
AND
DB_SHA_Trials_MirrorCharacters((CHARACTER)_Double, _)
AND
_Template != MAG_Critical_CriticalExecution_Ring_2f2d4bf3-6a14-43f5-81fe-e14aa9871215
AND
DB_SHA_Trials_ItemsToRemove(_Double, (ITEM)_Item)
THEN
PROC_Poof(_Item);
RequestDelete(_Item);

IF
ObjectTimerFinished(_, "WYR_CourageTest_General")
AND
DB_WYR_CourageTest_Tester(_Player, _)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Player, "WYR_COURAGEBRIGHT", S_WYR_CourageTest_Torch_c0022e77-6409-498b-83d9-2ca43ee4fa04);
